info.title: convt API
info.summary: Convert files with the engines from the convt desktop app, from your own code.
info.description: A conversion is a job. Reserve it with POST /v1/jobs, PUT the file to the returned upload_url, then POST /v1/jobs/{id}/start. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{id} until the job finishes, then GET /v1/jobs/{id}/download for signed output URLs. Inputs and outputs are deleted 24 hours after the job is created. The API sends no webhooks.

servers.description: Interim host. https://api.convt.app is the intended canonical host and will replace this once its DNS is live.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Reserve, upload, start, poll, download and cancel conversions. Every job belongs to the account that owns the credential; another account's job is a 404.

tags.name: Formats
tags.description: The format table the API validates against. Public; no credential needed.

post.description: Reserves one conversion against your spend cap and returns a presigned upload URL that works for 15 minutes. PUT exactly input_bytes bytes to it: the signature binds Content-Length. Nothing is charged until the job succeeds. If the upload URL cannot be issued, the job is cancelled and the reservation released.

200.description: The job is reserved in status `created`.

400.description: `file_too_large`: input_bytes is below 1 or above 2,000,000,000. `unsupported_format`: an unknown format, the same format twice, or a pair the cloud cannot convert. Malformed JSON also returns 400, as plain text.

403.description: `unauthorized`: the key is invalid or revoked, or the web credential expired. `not_enrolled`: no active API billing with a card on file. `limit_reached`: this job would pass your monthly spend cap. `storage_limit_reached`: 100 jobs or 50 GB of inputs are still stored; they are freed when their 24-hour cleanup runs.

get.description: Returns the job's current status. Poll this after start; a job runs for at most 10 minutes per attempt. Expired jobs return 404.

post.description: Seals the uploaded file, checks that its size matches input_bytes and queues the job. Call it once the PUT has succeeded. Starting a job that is no longer `created` changes nothing and returns it as it is, so retries are safe.

400.description: `size_mismatch`: the uploaded size differs from input_bytes or passes 2 GB. The job is cancelled and its reservation released.

post.description: Cancels a job that has not finished and releases its reservation, so it is never charged. A job that already succeeded, failed or was cancelled is returned unchanged; check its status to see which happened.

get.description: Returns a signed GET URL for every output of a succeeded job. A conversion can produce several files, such as one image per PDF page. The URLs last at most 5 minutes and never past the job's expiry; call again for fresh ones.

Every format convt knows, with its id, extensions and MIME type. Use the ids in input_format and target_format. Not every pair converts in the cloud; creating a job for one that does not returns `unsupported_format`.

bearerAuth.description: An API key: `cvt_live_` followed by 32 lowercase letters and digits, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create keys on the dashboard under API once API billing has a card. The browser converter on convt.app uses a 5-minute `cvt_web_` credential that only convt.app can issue.

JobId.name: id
JobId.description: The job id returned when the job was created.

InvalidCredential.description: `unauthorized`: the key is invalid or revoked, or the web credential expired.

NotFound.description: `not_found`: no such job for this account, or it expired.

RateLimited.description: `rate_limited`: more than 120 requests in a minute with this key. The window starts with the first request and lasts 60 seconds; no Retry-After header is sent.

Internal.description: `internal`: the request failed on our side. Retry with backoff.

StorageUnavailable.description: `storage_unavailable`: object storage did not respond. Retry shortly.

NotJson.description: The request has no `Content-Type: application/json` header. The body is plain text, not an Error.

InvalidBody.description: The JSON is valid but a field is missing, has the wrong type, or is not one of the three allowed. The body is plain text, not an Error.

input_format.description: Format id of the file you will upload, from GET /v1/formats.

target_format.description: Format id to convert to. Must differ from input_format.

input_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes. The upload must match it.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL. PUT the file body to it with a Content-Length of exactly input_bytes.

upload_expires_in.description: Seconds until upload_url stops working. Always 900.

input_bytes.description: The reserved input size in bytes.

attempt.description: How many times a worker has started this job. 0 until it first runs; a job is tried at most 3 times.

error_code.description: Why the job failed, or null.

expires_at.description: 24 hours after creation. After this the job returns 404 and its files are deleted.

JobStatus.description: Where the job is in its lifecycle. `succeeded`, `failed` and `cancelled` are final.

x-enum-descriptions.created: Reserved and waiting for the upload and start.
x-enum-descriptions.uploaded: Reserved for future use; the API does not return it today.
x-enum-descriptions.queued: Upload sealed; waiting for a worker.
x-enum-descriptions.succeeded: Outputs are ready to download. The conversion is charged.
x-enum-descriptions.failed: The conversion did not finish. Not charged; see error_code.
x-enum-descriptions.cancelled: Cancelled before it finished. Not charged.

JobErrorCode.description: The reason a job ended in `failed`.

x-enum-descriptions.conversion_failed: The engine could not convert this file, or the attempt passed the 10-minute limit.
x-enum-descriptions.worker_shutdown: The worker stopped during the attempt.
x-enum-descriptions.expired: The job reached its 24-hour expiry before finishing.
x-enum-descriptions.expired_or_exhausted: The job expired, or its last attempt's worker stopped responding.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the URLs stop working: at most 300.

name.description: File name the converter produced, such as `input.webp`. Rename it when saving.

url.description: Signed GET URL for the file.

message.description: A sentence for people. May change; branch on code.
message.example: Your allowance or spend cap has been reached.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable reason a request was refused.

x-enum-descriptions.unauthorized: 401 without a Bearer header; 403 when the key is invalid or revoked, or the web credential expired.
x-enum-descriptions.unsupported_format: 400. Unknown format, the same format twice, or a pair the cloud cannot convert.
x-enum-descriptions.size_mismatch: 400. The upload's size differs from input_bytes. The job is cancelled.
x-enum-descriptions.not_ready: 400. Download was called before the job succeeded.
x-enum-descriptions.not_enrolled: 403. API billing is not active with a card on file.
x-enum-descriptions.limit_reached: 403. The job would pass this month's spend cap.
x-enum-descriptions.storage_limit_reached: 403. 100 jobs or 50 GB of inputs are still stored until their 24-hour cleanup.
x-enum-descriptions.not_found: 404. No such job for this account, or it expired.
x-enum-descriptions.rate_limited: 429. More than 120 requests in a minute with this key.
x-enum-descriptions.internal: 500. Our side failed. Retry with backoff.
x-enum-descriptions.storage_unavailable: 502. Object storage did not respond. Retry shortly.
